prompts.name: Candle and shoulder

prompts.prompt: Mara turns to look back over her shoulder.

prompts.name: Rain on the glass

prompts.prompt: Mara rests her forehead on rainy glass.

prompts.name: Morning stretch

prompts.prompt: Mara stretches across the sheets.

builder.subject: She stretches forward across the sheets, then settles with her chin on her folded arms as the robe slips to her waist.

prompts.prompt: Ivo shifts his weight and looks past the lens.

prompts.prompt: Ivo leans on the counter in the dark.

builder.subject: He sets a glass on the counter, leans his hip into it, and looks down into the dark room.

prompts.prompt: Sera works oil across her collarbone in the mirror.

prompts.prompt: Mara settles back on the sofa and looks toward the easel.

prompts.prompt: Sera steps onto the balcony and the wind takes her robe.

prompts.name: Library lamp

prompts.prompt: Ivo closes the book and sits back under the lamp.

prompts.prompt: Mara turns toward the lantern inside the tent.

prompts.prompt: Lenn extends a hand over the low fire.

prompts.prompt: Mara tips her head as her partner's mouth meets her throat.

prompts.prompt: Mara settles into her partner's lap until their foreheads touch.

prompts.prompt: Ivo warms both hands around a cup.
